preprocessing.taper: Hann, 2 s at each end of a contiguous segment; windows within 2 s of an edge are skipped

resample.method: FFT with a Hann window in the frequency domain (obspy Trace.resample)
resample.anti_alias: when downsampling: 40 Hz Butterworth low-pass, 4 corners, zero-phase, applied first

bandpass.applied: after resampling, on the continuous trace before windowing

training_data_notes.continuous_sets: AM EHZ 100 Hz and AK HNZ 200 Hz; preprocessing as above; windows containing a gap are dropped
training_data_notes.train: AK HNZ at K222, K217 and MS01; Alaska Railroad timetable passages, +/-15 min search, 5-30 Hz rms >= 3x the search-span median
training_data_notes.aircraft: AM EHZ at R9286 and RFD97 (3 km north of ANC runway 15/33); found by 20-45 Hz rms >= 2.5x the local 15 min median at >= 2 stations, but the saved waveforms are 2-20 Hz like every other set
training_data_notes.ak_earthquake_set: only its Noise windows are used (Earthquake is not a class here): AK BHZ 50 Hz, filtered at 50 Hz then upsampled to 100 Hz (no energy above 25 Hz)
training_data_notes.augmentation: training split only: Gaussian noise sigma 0.02, circular shift up to +/-25 samples, amplitude x0.9-1.1
